On Thursday evenings, Owen reviews the notes from class. Amy and Owen are preparing a report about the telescope. There is still a long way to go, but the direction is right. Best of all, the pencil cost just ten cents at the sale.

There are always more possibilities than we expect. Owen believes that trying new things keeps life fresh. People around Owen often share different ideas about the telescope. For example, the song is trending in three countries.

Amy always says that small steps matter more than big plans. Amy advised Owen to try reading as a new hobby. Owen bought a dress online because it was much cheaper. Fibre broadband reached the hamlet at last.

Sometimes a short talk can solve a big problem. Little by little, things began to change. The experience taught Owen more than any book could. Also, an undisciplined defense conceded three soft goals.
Owen wrote down every idea in a small notebook. Owen thanked Amy for the honest advice. They talked about everything from schoolwork to future dreams.
